purpose: Provide an independent analytic trajectory and fixed-step RK4 oracle for a fixture-local three-axis translational model.

provenance.notes: The model, cases and tolerances are fixture-local. The analytic reference uses CPython decimal closed forms; the C++17 probe independently implements classical RK4 and commit-on-success bookkeeping.

expected_facts.claim: Declared initial conditions produce the stored high-precision constant-acceleration and linear-drag trajectories.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Position and velocity use separate absolute-plus-relative tolerances from cases.json; tick and semantic identities are exact.

expected_facts.claim: Classical fixed-step RK4 converges toward the independent linear-drag solution at fourth order.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Position and velocity endpoint errors must strictly decrease; every adjacent observed order is at least 3.8 and finest-grid limits come from cases.json.

expected_facts.claim: The altitude predicate first becomes true at committed tick 10 and the trajectory ends on that tick.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Predicate, first-satisfied tick and trajectory length are exact; state values use their declared field tolerances.

expected_facts.claim: A k2 evaluation-domain failure discards the candidate and preserves committed tick 1 and its state.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Failure code, stage, evaluation time, candidate disposition and committed tick are exact; committed state values use field tolerances.

acceptance: Contains explicit initial conditions, independent analytic trajectories, convergence, committed-tick termination and numerical failure checks
Addresses results by semantic case and quantity identity without Legacy node names or CSV column order
C++ and Python implementations remain isolated from product and Legacy code
